福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

普濟殿Puji Temple

認識全臺最早的王爺廟：從觀音小佛寺到寧靖王賜名，再到蜘蛛結網的風水與千盞手繪燈籠。

Meet Taiwan's oldest Wangye temple: a Buddhist hall, a prince's name, a spiderweb of lanes and a thousand painted lanterns.

從米街往北走幾步，就是號稱全臺最早的王爺廟。它在 1668 年是一座供奉觀音的小佛寺。後來一位旅人留下池府千歲神像，信徒越來越多。池府千歲是驅瘟的王爺。傳說之一，祂為了救百姓吞下瘟毒。寧靖王朱術桂散步時喜歡在此歇腳，並賜名「普濟殿」。看看地圖：巷弄像蛛網般放射，廟坐在正中心，網住好運。2013 年起，每逢農曆春節，上千盞手繪燈籠在這裡亮起，每一盞都不一樣。

A short walk north of Rice Street stands what is said to be the oldest Wangye temple in all of Taiwan. It began in 1668 as a small Buddhist hall for Guanyin. Then a traveler left a statue of Lord Chi, and believers kept coming. Lord Chi is one of the Royal Lords, gods who drive away plague. In one legend, he swallowed poison to save his people. Zhu Shugui, Prince of Ningjing, liked to rest here on his walks. He gave the temple its name: Puji Hall. Look at a map. The lanes spread out like a spiderweb, and the temple sits in the center, catching good fortune. Since 2013, over a thousand hand-painted lanterns have glowed here every Lunar New Year, and every one is different.

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 從觀音佛寺到王爺廟普濟殿可追溯到明鄭時期，多數說法是 1668 年。Puji Temple dates back to the Ming-loyalist era, to 1668 by most accounts.
  2. 親王賜名與蜘蛛結網一位明朝親王留下廟名，風水師看見一張網。A Ming prince gave the name, and feng shui masters saw a web.
  3. 千盞手繪燈籠2013 年起，每逢農曆春節，廟埕上空就亮起普濟燈會。Since 2013, the Puji Lantern Festival has lit up every Lunar New Year.

認識景點

About the place

從觀音佛寺到王爺廟From Buddhist hall to Wangye temple

普濟寺：原本是供奉觀音的木造小佛寺，名叫「普濟寺」，意思是普遍救濟眾生。 旅人留下的神像：相傳一位來自同安的旅人在此留宿，留下了池府千歲的神像。 王爺：是驅瘟逐疫的神明；池府千歲靈驗，後來成為主神。 瘟疫：古時候傳染病可怕，人們向王爺祈求平安。

A hall for Guanyin: It began as a small wooden Buddhist hall for Guanyin. Puji means universal salvation. A statue left behind: Story says a traveler from Tong'an stayed here and left a statue of Lord Chi. Royal Lords: The Royal Lords drive away plague. Lord Chi became the main god here. plague: Long ago, plague was terrifying, so people prayed to the Royal Lords for safety.

吞毒救民的傳說：傳說之一：池王爺發現有人要在井裡下瘟毒，便自己吞下毒藥救了百姓，臉因此變得黝黑。 郊商擴建：清代地方郊商集資擴建，讓它成為府城第一座王爺廟。

The poison legend: In one legend, Lord Chi swallowed poison meant for a well to save his people, and his face turned dark. Merchants build it bigger: In the Qing era, local merchants paid to make the temple bigger.

親王賜名與蜘蛛結網A prince's name and a spiderweb

寧靖王朱術桂：相傳寧靖王散步時喜歡到這裡歇腳，後來賜名「普濟殿」。 從「廟」到「殿」：「殿」是宮殿般的大殿，這個名字讓小廟升格了。 同一位王爺：五妃廟的五位妃子，就是寧靖王的妃子；他的名字在府城一再出現。 蜘蛛結網穴：周邊巷弄向四面八方放射，廟正好坐在網中心，風水上說能網住飄過舊城的好運。

Zhu Shugui, Prince of Ningjing: Story says the prince liked to stop here on his walks, and later named it Puji Hall. From temple to hall: A hall sounds like part of a palace, so the new name was an upgrade. The same prince: The five consorts honored at the Five Consorts Temple belonged to this same prince. The spider-web nexus: The lanes spread out like a web, with the temple as the spider. The web is said to catch good fortune.

用手機地圖描一描：進廟之前打開手機地圖，那張放射狀的蛛網是真的。

Trace it on your phone: Before you go in, trace the lanes on your phone's map. The web is real.

千盞手繪燈籠A thousand painted lanterns

普濟燈會：上千盞燈籠掛滿廟埕，一路延伸到國華街。 每一盞都是手繪：小學生、店家、藝術家、阿嬤都來畫，每一盞都不一樣。 黃昏再來一趟：春節到元宵之間，天黑後燈籠連成一條光之河。 剪紙巷：廟旁小巷的牆上，貼滿剪紙藝術。

Puji Lantern Festival: Over a thousand lanterns hang over the temple square and along Guohua Street. Every one hand-painted: Schoolchildren, shop owners, artists and grandmothers paint them, and no two are alike. Come back at dusk: Between Lunar New Year and the Lantern Festival, come after dark to see a river of light. Paper-Cut Alley: The lane beside the temple is decorated with paper-cut art.

王爺生平壁畫：2018 年青年畫家許荷西完成新壁畫，畫進五條港風景與池府千歲的故事。 木雕裡的恐龍：相傳後來整修時，匠師在木雕之間藏了一隻恐龍當彩蛋。看誰先找到！

A mural of Lord Chi's life: A mural from 2018 tells Lord Chi's story and shows the old Five Channels area. A dinosaur in the carvings: A dinosaur is said to hide among the wood carvings. Who can find it first?
